definitions.gloss: restless; fidgety; bustling; unable to settle down
definitions.explanation: Describes a state of being unable to relax, constantly feeling rushed or agitated. Can describe either a person's temperament or a hectic atmosphere.

examples.japanese: ⟦{年末|ねんまつ}→年末：17688_nenmatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{気忙|きぜわ}しい。
examples.english: The end of the year is hectic.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧{気忙|きぜわ}しく⟦{動|うご}き{回|まわ}っている→動き回る：04612_ugokimawaru⟧。
examples.english: He is always bustling about restlessly.

examples.japanese: {引|ひ}っ{越|こ}し⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{準備|じゅんび}→準備：01431_junbi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{気忙|きぜわ}しい⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{送|おく}っている→送る：00742_okuru⟧。
examples.english: I'm spending hectic days preparing for the move.

notes:
USAGE:
{気忙|きぜわ}しい describes an internal feeling of restlessness rather than simply being busy. A person who is {気忙|きぜわ}しい may not actually have a lot to do, but feels rushed and unsettled.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {気忙|きぜわ}しい⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧ (hectic days)
- {気忙|きぜわ}しく⟦{走|はし}り{回|まわ}る→走り回る：04608_hashirimawaru⟧ (to run around restlessly)
- {気忙|きぜわ}しい⟦{性格|せいかく}→性格：03371_seikaku⟧ (a restless personality)

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{忙|いそが}しい→忙しい：00591_isogashii⟧ simply means "busy" with tasks, while {気忙|きぜわ}しい emphasizes the psychological state of being unable to calm down. ⟦{慌|あわ}ただしい→慌ただしい：17686_awatadashii⟧ describes a situation that is hurried and chaotic.
